name: Project dependencies: settings UX + related-project search + FileExplorer project badge
description:
GOAL
Make "Project dependencies" a first-class, easy-to-use project setting, and make search cover the current project plus its child and dependency projects. Add a visual indication in the FileExplorer for folders that are codx-junior projects.

CONTEXT FOUND IN THE CODEBASE
- Backend settings model: `api/codx/junior/settings.py` (`CODXJuniorSettings`).
  - `project_dependencies: Optional[str]` — a plain comma separated string of project NAMES.
  - `get_project_dependencies()` splits that string on ",".
  - `get_sub_projects()` / `get_sub_projects_paths()` discover child projects by globbing `**/.codx/project.json`.
  - Existing related flags: `wiki_search_children`, `wiki_search_depth`, `knowledge_query_subprojects`.
- Client store already understands dependencies: `client/src/store/project.js`
  - `getProjectDependencies(project)` splits `project_dependencies` on "," and matches the names against `$storex.projects.allProjects`.
  - `getRelatedProjects(project)` = project + parent + children + dependencies and is used by mention/file search.
- Settings UI: `client/src/views/ProjectSettings.vue` has TWO copies of the general tab (mobile ~line 141 and desktop ~line 515) that render dependencies as a free text `<input>` labelled "Dependencies / List of external libraries or modules required" — misleading, and the user must type exact project names by hand.
- File listing: `api/codx/junior/engine/file_engine.py` → `parse_file_line()` builds the entry dict (`name`, `file_path`, `is_dir`, `is_ignored`, `children`, `last_modification`, `size`); `read_directory()` returns `{path, full_path, is_ignored, files}`. Client view: `client/src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` (props `root-path`, `this.$project.$api`, `viewMode` list/grid/preview, context menu already offers "New codx-junior project").

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. Selecting dependencies is a picker (no free text): searchable multi-select of the projects known to the instance, showing icon + name, with chips and a remove action, an explanation of what a dependency is used for, and a visible warning for entries that no longer resolve to a project. Stored value stays backward compatible (`comma,separated,names`) so `client/src/store/project.js` keeps working.
2. Backend exposes the resolved related projects (current + children + dependencies) through a single helper used by the knowledge/wiki search paths, gated by a project setting, so searching finds information in dependency projects too.
3. FileExplorer shows a clear indicator (icon/badge + tooltip) on folders that are codx-junior projects (a folder containing `.codx/project.json`), in every view mode.
4. No regression on existing project.json files (old comma string still parses) and no unrelated refactors.
